user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Write a CloudFormation template provisioning an ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: ECS Fargate cluster with two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer (NLB)

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name to prefix resource names
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+$'
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
  ServiceAImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI for Service A
  ServiceBImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI for Service B
  ServiceAPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Container/listener port for Service A
  ServiceBPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    Description: Container/listener port for Service B
  ServiceAListenerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
  ServiceBListenerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
  ServiceADesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceBDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceAMinDesired:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceAMaxDesired:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceBMinDesired:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceBMaxDesired:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceATargetCPU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
  ServiceBTargetCPU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
  ServiceATaskCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
  ServiceATaskMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168, 8192, 9216, 10240, 11264, 12288, 13312, 14336, 15360, 16384, 30720]
  ServiceBTaskCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
  ServiceBTaskMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168, 8192, 9216, 10240, 11264, 12288, 13312, 14336, 15360, 16384, 30720]
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1,3,5,7,14,30,60,90,120,150,180,365,400,545,731,1096,1827,2192,2557,2922,3288,3653]

Mappings: {}

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-a

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-b

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-a

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-b

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEipA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-a

  NatEipB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-b

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-a

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-b

  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-a

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-b

  PrivateRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  PrivateRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB

  TaskSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks allowing NLB traffic
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-sg

  NLB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: network
      Scheme: internal
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nlb

  TargetGroupA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceAPort
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-tg-a

  TargetGroupB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceBPort
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-tg-b

  NlbListenerA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref NLB
      Port: !Ref ServiceAListenerPort
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupA

  NlbListenerB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref NLB
      Port: !Ref ServiceBListenerPort
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupB

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
        - FARGATE_SPOT
      DefaultCapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Base: 1
          Weight: 1
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE_SPOT
          Weight: 1
      Configuration:
        ExecuteCommandConfiguration:
          Logging: DEFAULT
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster

  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-exec-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-exec-role

  EcsTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-role

  LogsGroupA:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-a
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  LogsGroupB:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-b
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  ServiceATaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceATaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref ServiceATaskMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-a
          Image: !Ref ServiceAImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogsGroupA
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-a

  ServiceBTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceBTaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref ServiceBTaskMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-b
          Image: !Ref ServiceBImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogsGroupB
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-b

  ServiceA:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NlbListenerA
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ServiceATaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref ServiceADesiredCount
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      CapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Base: 1
          Weight: 1
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE_SPOT
          Weight: 1
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      LaunchType: !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupA
          ContainerName: service-a
          ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort

  ServiceB:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NlbListenerB
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ServiceBTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref ServiceBDesiredCount
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      CapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Base: 1
          Weight: 1
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE_SPOT
          Weight: 1
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      LaunchType: !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupB
          ContainerName: service-b
          ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort

  AppAutoScalingSLR:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for ECS Application Auto Scaling

  ServiceAScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceA
      - AppAutoScalingSLR
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ServiceAMaxDesired
      MinCapacity: !Ref ServiceAMinDesired
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceA.ServiceName}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AppAutoScalingSLR.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ServiceBScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceB
      - AppAutoScalingSLR
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ServiceBMaxDesired
      MinCapacity: !Ref ServiceBMinDesired
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceB.ServiceName}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AppAutoScalingSLR.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ServiceAScalingPolicyCPU:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceAScalableTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a-cpu-policy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceAScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref ServiceATargetCPU
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  ServiceBScalingPolicyCPU:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceBScalableTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b-cpu-policy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceBScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref ServiceBTargetCPU
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-VpcId
  PrivateSubnets:
    Description: Private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnets
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster Name
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-EcsClusterName
  NlbArn:
    Description: Internal NLB ARN
    Value: !Ref NLB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-NlbArn
  NlbDNSName:
    Description: Internal NLB DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt NLB.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-NlbDNS
  ServiceAName:
    Description: ECS Service A Name
    Value: !Ref ServiceA
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ServiceA
  ServiceBName:
    Description: ECS Service B Name
    Value: !Ref ServiceB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ServiceB
  TargetGroupAArn:
    Description: Target Group A ARN
    Value: !Ref TargetGroupA
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-TgA
  TargetGroupBArn:
    Description: Target Group B ARN
    Value: !Ref TargetGroupB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-TgB

    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEipA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-a

  NatEipB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-b

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-a

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-b

  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-a

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-b

  PrivateRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  PrivateRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB

  TaskSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks allowing NLB traffic
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-sg

  NLB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: network
      Scheme: internal
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nlb

  TargetGroupA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceAPort
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-tg-a

  TargetGroupB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceBPort
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-tg-b

  NlbListenerA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref NLB
      Port: !Ref ServiceAListenerPort
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupA

  NlbListenerB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref NLB
      Port: !Ref ServiceBListenerPort
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupB

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
        - FARGATE_SPOT
      DefaultCapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Base: 1
          Weight: 1
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE_SPOT
          Weight: 1
      Configuration:
        ExecuteCommandConfiguration:
          Logging: DEFAULT
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster

  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-exec-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-exec-role

  EcsTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-role

  LogsGroupA:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-a
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  LogsGroupB:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-b
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  ServiceATaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceATaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref ServiceATaskMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-a
          Image: !Ref ServiceAImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogsGroupA
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-a

  ServiceBTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceBTaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref ServiceBTaskMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-b
          Image: !Ref ServiceBImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogsGroupB
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-b

  ServiceA:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NlbListenerA
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ServiceATaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref ServiceADesiredCount
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      CapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Base: 1
          Weight: 1
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE_SPOT
          Weight: 1
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      LaunchType: !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupA
          ContainerName: service-a
          ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort

  ServiceB:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NlbListenerB
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ServiceBTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref ServiceBDesiredCount
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      CapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Base: 1
          Weight: 1
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE_SPOT
          Weight: 1
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      LaunchType: !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupB
          ContainerName: service-b
          ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort

  AppAutoScalingSLR:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for ECS Application Auto Scaling

  ServiceAScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceA
      - AppAutoScalingSLR
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ServiceAMaxDesired
      MinCapacity: !Ref ServiceAMinDesired
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceA.ServiceName}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AppAutoScalingSLR.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ServiceBScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceB
      - AppAutoScalingSLR
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ServiceBMaxDesired
      MinCapacity: !Ref ServiceBMinDesired
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceB.ServiceName}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AppAutoScalingSLR.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ServiceAScalingPolicyCPU:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceAScalableTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a-cpu-policy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceAScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref ServiceATargetCPU
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  ServiceBScalingPolicyCPU:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceBScalableTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b-cpu-policy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceBScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref ServiceBTargetCPU
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-VpcId
  PrivateSubnets:
    Description: Private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnets
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster Name
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-EcsClusterName
  NlbArn:
    Description: Internal NLB ARN
    Value: !Ref NLB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-NlbArn
  NlbDNSName:
    Description: Internal NLB DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt NLB.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-NlbDNS
  ServiceAName:
    Description: ECS Service A Name
    Value: !Ref ServiceA
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ServiceA
  ServiceBName:
    Description: ECS Service B Name
    Value: !Ref ServiceB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ServiceB
  TargetGroupAArn:
    Description: Target Group A ARN
    Value: !Ref TargetGroupA
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-TgA
  TargetGroupBArn:
    Description: Target Group B ARN
    Value: !Ref TargetGroupB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-TgB

message.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: ECS Fargate cluster with two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer (NLB)

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Environment name to prefix resource names
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+$'
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
  ServiceAImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI for Service A
  ServiceBImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI for Service B
  ServiceAPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Container/listener port for Service A
  ServiceBPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    Description: Container/listener port for Service B
  ServiceAListenerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
  ServiceBListenerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
  ServiceADesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceBDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceAMinDesired:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceAMaxDesired:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceBMinDesired:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceBMaxDesired:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceATargetCPU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
  ServiceBTargetCPU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
  ServiceATaskCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
  ServiceATaskMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168, 8192, 9216, 10240, 11264, 12288, 13312, 14336, 15360, 16384, 30720]
  ServiceBTaskCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
  ServiceBTaskMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [512, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168, 8192, 9216, 10240, 11264, 12288, 13312, 14336, 15360, 16384, 30720]
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1,3,5,7,14,30,60,90,120,150,180,365,400,545,731,1096,1827,2192,2557,2922,3288,3653]

Mappings: {}

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-a

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-b

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-a

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-b

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEipA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-a

  NatEipB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-b

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-a

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-b

  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-a

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-b

  PrivateRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  PrivateRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB

  TaskSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks allowing NLB traffic
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-sg

  NLB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: network
      Scheme: internal
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nlb

  TargetGroupA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceAPort
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-tg-a

  TargetGroupB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Protocol: TCP
      Port: !Ref ServiceBPort
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '60'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-tg-b

  NlbListenerA:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref NLB
      Port: !Ref ServiceAListenerPort
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupA

  NlbListenerB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref NLB
      Port: !Ref ServiceBListenerPort
      Protocol: TCP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupB

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
        - FARGATE_SPOT
      DefaultCapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Base: 1
          Weight: 1
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE_SPOT
          Weight: 1
      Configuration:
        ExecuteCommandConfiguration:
          Logging: DEFAULT
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster

  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-exec-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-exec-role

  EcsTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-role

  LogsGroupA:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-a
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  LogsGroupB:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-b
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  ServiceATaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-a
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceATaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref ServiceATaskMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-a
          Image: !Ref ServiceAImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogsGroupA
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-a

  ServiceBTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-b
      Cpu: !Ref ServiceBTaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref ServiceBTaskMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service-b
          Image: !Ref ServiceBImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogsGroupB
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: service-b

  ServiceA:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NlbListenerA
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ServiceATaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref ServiceADesiredCount
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      CapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Base: 1
          Weight: 1
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE_SPOT
          Weight: 1
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      LaunchType: !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupA
          ContainerName: service-a
          ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceAPort

  ServiceB:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - NlbListenerB
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ServiceBTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref ServiceBDesiredCount
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      CapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Base: 1
          Weight: 1
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE_SPOT
          Weight: 1
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      LaunchType: !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroupB
          ContainerName: service-b
          ContainerPort: !Ref ServiceBPort

  AppAutoScalingSLR:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for ECS Application Auto Scaling

  ServiceAScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceA
      - AppAutoScalingSLR
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ServiceAMaxDesired
      MinCapacity: !Ref ServiceAMinDesired
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceA.ServiceName}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AppAutoScalingSLR.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ServiceBScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceB
      - AppAutoScalingSLR
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ServiceBMaxDesired
      MinCapacity: !Ref ServiceBMinDesired
      ResourceId: !Sub service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceB.ServiceName}
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AppAutoScalingSLR.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ServiceAScalingPolicyCPU:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceAScalableTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-a-cpu-policy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceAScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref ServiceATargetCPU
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  ServiceBScalingPolicyCPU:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceBScalableTarget
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-svc-b-cpu-policy
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceBScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref ServiceBTargetCPU
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-VpcId
  PrivateSubnets:
    Description: Private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnets
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster Name
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-EcsClusterName
  NlbArn:
    Description: Internal NLB ARN
    Value: !Ref NLB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-NlbArn
  NlbDNSName:
    Description: Internal NLB DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt NLB.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-NlbDNS
  ServiceAName:
    Description: ECS Service A Name
    Value: !Ref ServiceA
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ServiceA
  ServiceBName:
    Description: ECS Service B Name
    Value: !Ref ServiceB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ServiceB
  TargetGroupAArn:
    Description: Target Group A ARN
    Value: !Ref TargetGroupA
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-TgA
  TargetGroupBArn:
    Description: Target Group B ARN
    Value: !Ref TargetGroupB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-TgB
